mapper.select: SELECT host_connections, client_connections, channel_count, upload_bytes_per_second, download_bytes_per_second, reported_at FROM tunnel_runtime_status WHERE tunnel_id = #{tunnelId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE trs FROM tunnel_runtime_status trs LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON t.tunnel_id = trs.tunnel_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE trs.reported_at < #{reportedBefore} OR t._id IS NULL
